mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing fair conditions near Verona Area High School with a temperature of 70 degrees. The City of Verona has officially adopted the 2027 Annual Budget. In other updates, the Public Works Department is reminding residents to properly dispose of fats, oils, and greases to prevent sewer clogs and protect our local waterways.
There are currently no local events on the calendar for the next 30 days, but we will be sure to update you as soon as new community gatherings are scheduled.
In our weekly police report, on November 4, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash where one driver was arrested for an O W I while a child was in the vehicle.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious OREO Cookie Cheesecake. The store is currently open and will be serving up scoops until 10 PM tonight.
